manifest.definition: Synthetic development cases plus parameter variants held out from workflow/prompt changes. Expected fields are evaluator-only. Offline replay is a deterministic scripted adapter.

resumes.authorization: User: check request amount and pause above1000; user reconfirms provider cap1/month. Earlier free-only and actual-charge pause retained.

limitations: Synthetic cases and simulated dispatcher approvals; not production traffic.
Held-out cases are small parameter variants, not a broad generalization benchmark.
Protocol-only cases skipped in live grading; excluded from denominators.
Native escalation and application budget stop distinguished in tool traces.
No source, prompt or model configuration changed between development and held-out.
Serial validation harness only; selected profile not yet in normally launched web app.
Paused active case ungraded and excluded; existing completed failures retained.
OpenRouter inference usage excludes credit-purchase fee and coding-assistant usage.
